items.title: Our Pick Of The Best Founder Led Stocks In November 2026
items.summary: Persistent inflation worries and the Federal Reserve openly weighing a larger interest rate hike have pushed investors to question which leaders can steer through higher borrowing costs without flinching. Founder run businesses often have more skin in the game, treating every dollar of shareholder capital like their own. This article walks through three founder led stocks from our US screener that fit that mindset and explains why they deserve a closer look now. The three stocks highlighted...

items.title: Moonshot Rents Nvidia's Top AI Chips in China, Documents Show
items.summary: Moonshot AI accessed a trove of Nvidia Corp.'s most advanced chips this summer, according to documents filed with Beijing regulators, highlighting the Chinese artificial intelligence champion's reliance on American hardware despite US export restrictions.
